description: Deliberate state store — ideas (pins), tasks with step checklists, important dates, contacts, attachments. Two boards (owner: david | machine). Registry-validated contexts. Backed by its own nDB database (data/notepad/) with file buckets for attachments. Exposes LLM tools plus REST routes (/notepad/*) on the same server for manual editing and dashboard components.

tools.name: notepad_add
tools.description: Add an item to the notepad. owner is REQUIRED ('david' = David's board, maintained as secretary on his request; 'machine' = the machine's own board, invisible to David unless he asks). Types: 'idea' (pin — title, notes, optional context, ref, body), 'task' (optional due YYYY-MM-DD, optional steps array of strings, context), 'date' (when YYYY-MM-DD, optional recur 'yearly', context), 'contact' (title + at least one of phone/email/address; no context). Returns the created item with its id.

title.description: short and human-legible — the post-it line

body.description: long payload — delivered only via notepad.get, never in list/snapshot

context.description: project/domain — must exist in the registry (see notepad.contexts)

ref.description: pointers, not copies: session ids, storage paths, URLs

steps.description: task only — ordered checklist; strings or {text, done}

tools.name: notepad_list
tools.description: List notepad items. Optional filters: type, status, owner (david|machine), context (registry-validated). Returns compact records; body is never included (use notepad.get).

tools.name: notepad_get
tools.description: Get one notepad item by id — the full record including steps, attachments, refs, and body (body is available ONLY here, never in list/snapshot).

tools.name: notepad_update
tools.description: Update fields on a notepad item. Common: title, notes, owner (moves the item between boards), context, ref (replaces the array), body. task: due, status (open|done|cancelled), steps (replaces the whole checklist). idea: status (open|promoted|archived). date: when, recur. contact: phone, email, address. Type cannot be changed (use notepad.promote for idea→task).

tools.name: notepad_complete
tools.description: Complete a task. With stepIndex: mark that step done (0-based). Without: mark the whole task done. Rejects non-task items.

tools.name: notepad_remove
tools.description: Delete a notepad item (soft delete — restorable via nDB). Releases the item's bucket attachments (trashed only if no other item references them).

tools.name: notepad_promote
tools.description: Promote an idea to a task: creates the task with the idea's title/notes/context/refs/body/owner and marks the idea 'promoted' with a link to the new task id.

tools.name: notepad_attach
tools.description: Attach a file (image, pdf, …) to an item. path is an absolute file path (e.g. an MCP_Storage path you wrote via storage.write). Stored in the nDB 'notepad' bucket with SHA-256 dedup; returns the attachment ref and its HTTP URL.

path.description: absolute path of the file to attach

name.description: display name, defaults to the file's basename

tools.name: notepad_snapshot
tools.description: The Today view, both boards (David's items first). Order: optional per-context project-start view (pass context), overdue tasks, due within 7 days, open tasks with step progress, upcoming dates (yearly recurrences mapped forward), 5 newest open ideas, stale pins (open ideas >2 months — cleanup prompts only, never acted on automatically), context registry footer. body never appears here. Read at session start; pass context when starting project work (the pin check).

context.description: include the project-start view for this context (open pins + open tasks)

tools.name: notepad_context_add
tools.description: Create a context in the registry. Canonical form: lowercase, hyphens (e.g. materna-bav). Rejects duplicates.

tools.name: notepad_contexts
tools.description: List all registered contexts. Read this before inventing a new context name.

tools.name: notepad_context_rename
tools.description: Rename a context (admin op): rewrites the registry entry and every item referencing it. No alias system — aliases recreate the drift problem.

tools.name: notepad_context_remove
tools.description: Remove a context from the registry. Refuses while any item still references it — move or clear those items first.
